The Visit

What to Expect

Crown Treatment

The in-salon experience refreshes the scalp with exfoliation, cleanse, massage, and treatment support.

Home-Care Plan

Your system is selected for your hair and scalp needs, then explained so you know exactly how to use it at home.

Daily Care

How to Use Your 3-Step Kit

  1. Cleanse: Massage the cleanser shampoo into the scalp and hair to remove buildup and residue.
  2. Condition: Apply conditioner through the scalp and lengths to support moisture and stronger-feeling hair.
  3. Leave-In: Apply the scalp and hair treatment as directed, focusing on consistency between appointments.
  4. Maintain: Use your system regularly and return for continued scalp-care support when recommended.
